lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Before you swing, rookie rules. I talk, you listen. Aim with the arrow buttons on your screen. Point her at the hole, not where the wind wants.

lines.speaker: may
lines.text: Buttons to aim. Even I can manage that. Then what?

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Hold the launch button to charge your shot, release to shoot. Longer hold, bigger swing. Do not get greedy in a gale.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Drag an item from your bag and drop it on the course to place it. Double-tap a placed gadget to pick it back up. And if it all goes sideways, tap the reset button to go back to the tee, or the menu button to pause.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Listen up. When you have a good direction you want to keep, use a Liquifier — it nullifies the wind and preserves your line.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: If the wind is not blowing the way you need, use a Deflector to flip it 180 degrees or a Rotator to turn it 90 degrees.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: If you need more power, drop a Magnifier — it magnifies the wind five times.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: And remember: field modifiers can be placed on top of each other to combine their effects. Stack them wisely.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Drag one modifier right on top of another and they snap together into a stack — you will see the rim split into each gadget's color.

lines.speaker: caddy
lines.text: Changed your mind? Double-tap a stack to split it back apart, or double-tap a lone gadget to pick it back up.
